note: Lean does not use the convolution S_{η₂*_Mφ}(α,y) with Prop 11.2.1 at one scale y; it writes S_{η*} = ∫ S_{η₂}(α,wy)φ(w)dw/w, takes a fresh Dirichlet approximation at each scale wy, and integrates (Prop 11.2.3′). The resulting bound is y·ĝ(y,n)-type, not g_{y,φ}(r)|φ|₁y.

rcases le_or_gt (q : ℝ) (z ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6) with hq | hq
  · have key := norm_S_eta2_le_gx hz h hq (by linarith)
    have hup := r_le_cube_root hz h hq
    have hmono := gx_antitoneOn hz ⟨hlow, hrw.trans hup⟩ ⟨hlow.trans hrw, hup⟩ hrw
    calc ‖S eta2 z α‖ ≤ gx z (max 1 (|δ| / 8) * q) * z := key
      _ ≤ G * z := by
          gcongr
          exact hmono.trans (hG1 (hrw.trans hup))

proof_context.conclusion: For q ≤ z^{1/3}/6 and α ∉ 𝔐_{8,n}(y): |S_{η₂}(α,z)| ≤ g_z(max(1,|δ|/8)q)·z ≤ g_z(min(1,w)n)·z, using r_w ≥ min(1,w)n and `gx_antitoneOn`.

(hGi : IntegrableOn (fun w => G w * phi w) (Icc w₀ w₁)) :
    ‖S etaStar x α‖ ≤ x / κ * ((∫ w in Icc w₀ w₁, G w * phi w) +
      17 * ((∫ w in Ioo 0 w₀, phi w) + ∫ w in Ioi w₁, phi w)) := by
  have hκ : (0 : ℝ) < κ := by rw [TernaryGoldbach.Helfgott.κ]; norm_num
  set y := x / κ with hy_def
  have hy0 : 0 < y := div_pos hx hκ
  have hn0 : 0 ≤ n := by
    by_contra h; push Not at h; nlinarith
  refine norm_S_etaStar_le_of_pointwise hx hw₀ (by linarith) (fun w hw => ?_) hGi
  have hw0 : 0 < w := lt_of_lt_of_le hw₀ hw.1
  refine norm_S_eta2_le_of_not_mem hy0 hα hw0
    (hy.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hw.1 hy0.le)) ?_ (hG1 w hw) (hG2 w hw)
  have : w₀ ≤ min 1 w := le_min hw₀1 hw.1
  nlinarith

proof_context.conclusion: Integrating the pointwise scale-wy bounds against φ(w)dw/w gives |S_{η*}(α,x)| ≤ y(∫Gφ + 17(∫_0^{w₀}φ+∫_{w₁}^∞φ)).
